source_read_findings: PR4932 proposes worker-side registration and safe optional-attribute probes. Its author reports a real PushT run; not replicated here.
Metric mask and negative-reward maximum defects already have upstream PR4485 f689403357200e6c31f43fc6b5b77ae850693962; any reproducer must credit that work.

SAME_STEP supplies the next episode reset observation and retains final_obs in info; the evaluator observation-history path appears to omit that substitution. Native execution has not yet tested this suspicion.

metrics.expected: First short failed episode: sum=-2,max=-2,success=false; longer episode: sum=3,max=1,success=true; 1/2 aggregated successes.

episode_observations.expected: For each original episode, recorded state starts at its assigned seed and increments by applied actions through terminal state; never next-episode reset state.

optional_attributes.expected: Workers remain usable; description preferred, task fallback, empty string otherwise; exact long-episode actions 43,44,45.

reuse.expected: Reused linked processors on seeds73,74 equal freshly constructed pipelines at those seeds for all actions,rewards,success,done and policy inputs.

adaptation: Use forkserver matching upstream factory; preserve SameStep (its configured default) and NextStep controls. Contract is checked against explicit action-dependent fixture, not sync agreement alone. These are source-informed deterministic regressions, not blind or statistical confirmation.
